reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about Splash Pools DFW—they were better than awesome! From start to finish, their professionalism (Josh Curry & Josh Howard) and commitment to quality were unmatched. They were always available to answer any questions, no matter how big or small, and their communication made the entire process stress-free. The crew was on site daily, working hard and keeping us updated every step of the way. The attention to detail and pride in their work truly shows in the finished product. If you’re looking for a pool company that goes above and beyond, this is the one to choose!  Thank you Splash Pools DFW!!!
reviews.author: Chandra Babovec

reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience working with Josh Curry and Splash Pools, and I can’t recommend them enough. From start to finish, the entire process took less than six weeks, and not once did we feel like we were left waiting or wondering what was next.

Josh Curry is a second-generation pool builder, and it shows in everything he does. This isn’t your typical run-of-the-mill pool company. He brings deep knowledge, professionalism, and a no-pressure approach that makes a big difference. He consistently anticipated our questions and answered them before we could even ask. We never had to chase him down—he always called us first with updates and kept us in the loop every step of the way.

I also want to give a huge shoutout to Josh Howard, who taught me how to manage and take care of the pool myself. His guidance was clear, patient, and incredibly helpful. I walked away feeling confident in maintaining everything on my own.

If you’re looking for a pool builder who does things the right way, is easy to work with, and actually cares about quality and service, Splash Pools is it. I would 100% recommend them.
reviews.author: Nathan Red

reviews.text: We have absolutely loved our process with Josh and his amazing crews. One of my biggest dreams was having a pool. Josh was wonderful to work with and both our vision and his came together beautifully. We look forward to our phase 2 built later this year as we continue to make our homestead an oasis retreat. You can say it's both human and dog approved. Your in amazing hands!
reviews.author: Amber Walker

reviews.text:
If you need a pool Josh is the man to call. When I reached out to him he called me right back and came to my office to start the process. He was recommended by family and friends and I have know of his family for years. We made a plan for what we wanted and he delivered. Josh takes the time to listen and then creates the perfect pool. Josh also built our outdoor kitchen and treated this as if it was his own. No corners were cut. Josh educated us on the soil which resulted in piers to support the pool as we built on the lake. He brings additional knowledge that the consumer has no idea about. Actually he is the process of building our outdoor fire place in the pergola. Can't wait for the first fire out there!! Your the best!

Danielle Carlisle
reviews.author: Danielle Carlisle

reviews.text: Splash pools did an amazing job building our pool. This crew is incredibly professional. They helped us design the perfect pool for our family. If you need a pool this is the company to use.
reviews.author: Jake Haight

reviews.text: I built my pool with Splash Pools 2 years ago and had the best experience.  Josh came up with a great design that best fit my yard and the process was very professional from beginning to end.  They are still very helpful even after building if I have any equipment questions or need something fixed.  Would highly recommend Splash Pools if you are looking to build.
reviews.author: Hector Condarco

reviews.text: Josh Curry and his team at Splash Pools were amazing! We started my project in October 2022 and if it hadn’t been for the city delaying permits in December my pool would’ve been completed the by Christmas. Josh was involved in the entire project from start to finish. Anytime I had a question they were super responsive and were able to answer all my questions. Hands down I wouldn’t recommend any other Pool company.  They made my dream pool come to reality and I can’t wait to use it this summer
reviews.author: Lesa Frye

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience building our Splash Pool. Josh (the owner) was with us throughout the entire process. He worked with us and designed exactly what we dreamed of. He understood our vision and made it happen. We originally built the pool and came back to him a few years later to add our outdoor kitchen, which turned out amazing. Our backyard feels like we are on vacation every day, thanks to Splash Pools.
reviews.author: Briana Maechling

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. They contain specific details about projects, crew names, timelines, and outcomes. The writing styles are varied and emotionally genuine, describing personal experiences and long-term satisfaction. There are no discernible patterns of fake reviews or significant complaint trends. The high ratings across platforms are consistent with a quality contractor.
authentic_signals: Specific project details (pools, outdoor kitchens, timelines)
Mention of crew/owner names (Josh Curry, Josh Howard)
Mention of multi-year relationships and follow-up work
Emotional authenticity in describing dream fulfillment
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (4.8), Yelp (5.0), and BBB (A+). The lower Angi rating (3.8) is not a major discrepancy as it's a different platform with a different review base and still indicates a positive average.
